case_title: SHU KAY YAM ET AL VS. ARMSTRONG TOWNHOMES HOMEWOWNERS ASSOCIATION

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,500.00 FILED BY YAM, SHU KAY CHAU, KING CHUEN AS TO DEFENDANT ARMSTRONG TOWNHOMES HOMEWOWNERS ASSOCIATION ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-01-2021 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
ORDER RE CONTINUANCE FOR PROOF OF SERVICE; MATTER CONTINUED TO SEPTEMBER 1, 2021 AT 3:30 P.M. DEPT. 506.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-01-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO SEP-01-2021 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF SHU KAY YAM IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ARMSTRONG TOWNHOMES HOMEOWNERS IS NOT PRESENT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$40.00) SERVED JUL-06-2021, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT ARMSTRONG TOWNHOMES HOMEWOWNERS ASSOCIATION

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFFS SHU KAY YAM AND KING CHUEN CHAU ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT ARMSTRONG TOWNHOMES HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION, REPRESENTED BY GERALD JOSEPH, PROPERTY MANAGER/PRESIDENT IS PRESENT. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. COURT DISCUSSES WITH PLAINTIFF RE: FINES ASSES TO HIM BY THE HOA. PLAINTIFF TESTIFIES TO THE COURT THAT HE HAS NOT PAID ANY OF THE ASSES FINED TO THE HOA. COURT DETERMINES THAT THIS CLAIM IS NOT RIPE. PLAINTIFF CAN NOT SHOW THAT ANY MONETARY DAMAGES ARE OWED BY DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
REMARK: REMARK: EXHIBITS DESTROYED PER ORDER SIGNED BY JUDGE: ANNE-CHRISTINE MASSULLO ON NOVEMBER 8, 2024 PURSUANT TO SECTION 1952 OF THE CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE OF CALIFORNIA.
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)
